messages:
Maria L.: heads-up — CI flagged a regression in audit-event-validator on private branch.
Josh K.: link: https://builds.redwood/12345
ci-bot: [FAIL] audit-validator: golden-fixture-mismatch (tests/fixtures/customer_events/golden.json)
ci-bot: ```
Expected event type: customer.key.rotate
Actual event type: kms.key.rotate
Diff at events[4].type
``` 
Olivia S.: hmm this smells like the RBAC schema rename from last week — we changed actor.role -> principal.role in some codepaths.
Kevin P.: we also landed a KMS rotation telemetry change that renamed the event type to kms.key.rotate for internal consumers. Customers should still see customer.key.rotate though.
Maria L.: reproduction steps?
Josh K.: pulled branch, ran `pytest tests/validation/test_audit_roundtrip.py::test_golden_customer_events -k rotate -q` and got same failure locally.
Olivia S.: can we update the validator to accept both event.type variants temporarily? Customer-facing contract matters.
Kevin P.: +1 for conservative approach: validator should map backward-compatible aliases; longer-term we add a migration on ingest to normalize types.
Maria L.: action items: 1) small validator patch to accept alias (Josh), 2) update golden fixture to reflect canonical output after migration (Olivia), 3) create ticket for ingest normalization (Kevin).
Josh K.: I'll open PR with tests. Will include CI output and mention rollback plan.
ci-bot: PR #789 opened by Josh K. with 2 commits — runs queued.
ci-bot: [INFO] running schema-checker v0.9.1 on changed fixtures
audit-bot: alert: customer-facing audits are part of our SLA. Flagging on oncall.
security-oncall: oncall here — I want the fix gated behind a canary release to Dedicated customers only.
Olivia S.: noted. Put canary label in PR description.
Maria L.: also add a test that ensures both legacy and new event.type names are valid. We shouldn't break historical exports.
Josh K.: PR updated, added mapper test, added comment about KMS rename.
ci-bot: [PASS] schema-checker and golden-fixture-check
Maria L.: thanks team. Let's keep this in postmortem: where we track the rename and communication to integrations.
Kevin P.: opening ticket: SEC-2143 Audit event normalization + migration plan.
Olivia S.: I'll draft customer-facing note for support if we see any discrepant exports.
Maria L.: closing thread — followups in SEC-2143 and PR discussion. :thumbsup:
